scope: Read-only request-plan, partial-resume, budget, branch, and PreviewStore reuse detail; no source/schema/test/Git/connector/Vault/network mutation.

request_specs_and_plan_id.request_key: SHA256(b"rw3/request-key-v1\0" + JCS(spec_body)); plan_id is excluded; sequence and slot are included.
request_specs_and_plan_id.round_plan: Sealed object contains session/config refs, sequence, previous completed event ref, sorted request_specs and reservation. Each spec contains slot, request_key and complete spec_body; duplicate keys/slots refuse.
request_specs_and_plan_id.request: Sealed object carries session_id, plan_id, sequence, slot, request_key and exact spec_body. Validator recomputes key and requires exact equality to one plan entry. It rejects unknown plan, out-of-range/duplicate slot, duplicate key, changed bytes or filename/hash.
request_specs_and_plan_id.cycle_invariant: Plan contains no final request refs. Requests carry plan_id/key, not a full plan ref. The round event is the first object containing exact request refs, so plan_id is computable before children.
request_specs_and_plan_id.reservation_invariant: At plan commit reserve N=len(request_specs) request slots and N terminal-observation slots, even when zero request files have installed. Half-installed plans therefore cannot evade max_requests/max_observations by omitting pending children. Normalized bytes/results remain prospective checks.

algorithm: Retain checkout/.work/research/session/discovery-v1, all five family descriptors, complete names and first stat including originally absent expected targets.
Validate config/session/plans; index requests by (plan_id,slot), require exact key/spec, and treat only missing expected slots as writable.
Reject multiple first plans, multiple successors, competing same-slot requests or foreign entries; never choose by timestamp/arrival.
Install missing canonical requests only; reservation ledger remains N. Index observations by exact request ref and allow zero or one terminal outcome per request.
After every request has one terminal observation, derive candidate/rank/stop; existing children must match plan_id, sequence and input_set_sha256.
Require event exact sorted request/observation/projection refs, recompute set digests and budget_after, then atomic-install event last; rescan on normal and exception exits.
complete_set_invariants: Every plan slot 0..N-1 has exactly one matching request, or is explicitly pending; N never changes.
Every committed request has exactly one terminal observation; a second outcome is conflict, and retry is a new request in a later plan.
Every derived child has complete sorted input-set digest; orphan children remain pending and cannot authorize a successor.
Event is valid only if all slots, terminal observations, deterministic children, predecessor and ledger validate together; event-present/input-missing is integrity refusal.

budget_and_branches.accounting: No refund for failure, interruption, retry or orphan. Requests count when planned; terminal observations count for ok/not_found/timeout/rate_limited/failure/partial/zero-result. Payload bytes charge exact UTF-8 bytes on staging.
budget_and_branches.malformed_or_oversize: Reject before staging; no observation slot consumed and request stays pending. A bounded explicit failure observation may close it.
budget_and_branches.failure_timeout_rate_limit: One terminal evidence object, no candidate, no hidden retry; explicit retry references predecessor and is a new later-plan request consuming fresh reservations.
budget_and_branches.not_found: Terminal, counted, no candidate, no implicit retry.
budget_and_branches.zero_result: Valid ok observation with results=[] and explicit completeness; new/duplicate/unresolved counts zero and duplicate_ratio is null for zero denominator, never 100 percent.
budget_and_branches.partial: Terminal present results plus incomplete reason; candidates remain visible but gaps persist and ranking cannot upgrade completeness.
budget_and_branches.conflict: Competing plan, slot, terminal outcome, projection, successor or foreign sibling refuses without cleanup.

new_required: DiscoveryStore at discovery-v1 with new family map/content-hash filenames
must_not_reuse_as_is: PreviewStore root or W1 six-digit decision chain
W1 registry/kinds or W1 validate_graph as discovery authority
single-object write as a substitute for plan reservation and event-last finalization
preview_reuse_boundary.cycle_guard: Discovery graph validation checks active ancestry before memo-cache acceptance and enforces the explicit layer edges.

acceptance_vectors: Interrupt after every install step and resume to identical bytes/one event.
Half-install a plan and verify full N reservations prevent omitted-child budget evasion.
Exercise duplicate slots/outcomes, competing plans/orphans, stale sets, named-edge races and event-present/missing-child refusal.
remaining_gates: Freeze exact fields/enums/error codes and APIs before implementation.
No builder dispatch or source implementation is authorized by this detail review.
